calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, divide its trailing 20-session return by trailing 30-session daily-return volatility annualized by sqrt(252). Multiply by a market breadth hysteresis state computed from the fraction of the 15 instruments with positive 20-session returns: state is +1 when breadth is at least 65%, -1 when breadth is at most 35%, and otherwise retains the previous state. Higher values predict higher subsequent 10-session returns.

metrics.ic_definition: daily Spearman cross-sectional IC versus 10-trading-day forward returns

validation.regime_notes: Positive mean IC in 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029, 2030, and 2031; negative in 2032 and 2033 year-to-date. The small 15-instrument cross-section requires conservative interpretation. The 10-session horizon passes both benchmark-wide absolute IC and absolute ICIR gates.
validation.coverage_definition: Mean valid cross-section divided by 15 over dates with at least 8 valid instruments
